items.title: 구찌 가방 95만원 내렸다…콧대 높던 명품업계에 무슨 일이
items.summary: Gucci cut the Korean retail price of its Mercato small tote by 21.3% (KRW 4.45m to 3.50m), part of a broader pattern of luxury price cuts after years of hikes. The piece frames this as Gucci breaking a long-standing industry taboo of never lowering prices, following 13 consecutive quarters of declining sales.

items.title: 불황 속 구찌는 가방값 30% 내렸는데…루이비통은 망설이는 '명품의 금기'
items.summary: Contrasts Gucci's decision to cut handbag prices up to 30% (e.g. Padlock crystal bag from EUR3,500 to EUR2,450) against Louis Vuitton's reluctance to follow, citing brand-value erosion risk. Cites Kering CEO Luca de Meo acknowledging the group priced some items too high, hurting sales.

items.title: "사자마자 130만원 떨어�었어요"...명품값 인하에 기존 구매자들 '허탈'
items.summary: Reports organic consumer frustration after Gucci and Boucheron cut prices shortly following purchases at higher price points. Quotes an online luxury-community poster asking whether brands will offer price-difference compensation; none has been offered. Frames this as reputational fallout from the price-cut strategy, not just a neutral pricing story.

items.title: 콧대 꺾인 명품...중산층 지갑 닫자 '가격 백기'
items.summary: Broader trade piece on the luxury sector's pricing retreat as middle-class spending power shrinks; cites Gucci, Boucheron price cuts as evidence the 'luxury always raises prices' convention has broken. Secondhand/resale values for Kering's top three brands (Gucci, Balenciaga, Bottega Veneta) fell 10%, 14%, and 23% respectively over the past year.

items.title: 구찌와 머라이어 캐리가 완성한 눈부신 2026 홀리데이 풍경
items.summary: Descriptive write-up of Gucci's 2026 holiday campaign starring Mariah Carey, themed around her Butterfly motif. Purely descriptive of the activation (what it is, who stars) with no independent evaluative verdict.

items.title: 박보검·닝닝, LA 사로잡은 독보적 아우라... 제15회 구찌 LACMA 갈라 빛내다
items.summary: Descriptive coverage of Gucci ambassadors Park Bo-gum and aespa's Ningning attending the 15th LACMA Art+Film Gala presented by Gucci on Nov 7, 2026 in Los Angeles; outlines their outfits. No independent critical verdict offered.

items.title: 구찌, 새로운 글로벌 브랜드 앰버서더에 배우 박보검 선정
items.summary: Announcement that actor Park Bo-gum was named Gucci's new global brand ambassador effective November 2026. Descriptive press-release-style coverage with a quote from Park expressing excitement to work with creative director Demna.

items.source: theqoo (via secondary reporting of community reaction)
items.title: Korean community reaction to Park Bo-gum Gucci ambassador news
items.summary: Fan/community reaction aggregated from theqoo-style boards to Park Bo-gum's Gucci ambassador appointment: largely positive, with comments such as approval of Gucci's choice and excitement about pairing Demna's Gucci aesthetic with Park Bo-gum. Fandom-driven enthusiasm, magnitude damped per sentiment-rubric fandom trap.

items.title: Gucci cuts prices, but will Chinese shoppers return?
items.summary: Analysis questioning whether Gucci's price cuts in China (Mercato tote down ~22%, Ophidia mini bucket bag down ~40%) will actually win back Chinese shoppers, given deeper trust and relevance issues beyond price. Independent trade-press critical judgment on the turnaround strategy's limits.

items.title: Gucci to stage Cruise 2028 show in Shanghai
items.summary: Reports Gucci will hold its Cruise 2028 show in Shanghai on May 17, 2027, marking 30 years since its first China store opening, with Demna designing. Notes the announcement lands amid continued weak China store traffic and a 6% comparable revenue decline in Q3 2026.

items.title: 古驰悄悄降价最高40%：奢侈品"只涨不降"神话破灭
items.summary: Widely-reposted Weibo explainer thread framing Gucci's price cuts of up to 40% as breaking the luxury sector's long-held 'prices only go up' myth. Lists specific markdowns (Mercato tote, Ophidia bucket bag, ready-to-wear ~30% off) and ties it to Kering CEO's admission that pricing power had been overused.

items.title: 古驰2026大换血：CEO换帅、降价40%、Demna首秀，现在还能买吗？
items.summary: Weibo explainer post asking whether it's still worth buying Gucci given the 2026 shakeup (new CEO, 40% price cuts, Demna's debut collection). Mixed framing: treats price cuts as value opportunity for some readers but flags uncertainty over brand value trajectory for others.

items.title: 古驰最高降了40%，新款却按原价卖：现在买Gucci，先看清两套账
items.summary: Chinese consumer-community post criticizing Gucci's 'two sets of accounts' pricing: discounting classic/prior-season items up to 40% while keeping new Demna-era pieces at full price despite some now being made in China rather than Italy. Argues this creates buyer confusion about what justifies the price, and that brand narrative pricing persists even as production is outsourced.

items.title: グッチの「底打ち」に、中国が待ったをかけた。仏高級ブランド株は11%沈む
items.summary: Reports Kering shares fell 11% after Gucci's hoped-for China bottoming-out failed to materialize; frames China demand weakness as the central drag on the group's turnaround narrative. Slightly outside the tightest freshness window but still actively circulating in NEA financial press this week as context for the price-cut and Shanghai-show stories.

items.title: 11四半期連続マイナス、100店舗閉鎖＿いまグッチに何が起きているのか？
items.summary: Independent Japanese business-blog analysis arguing Gucci has been 'half-destroyed' as a brand over three years, citing 11+ consecutive quarters of sales declines and 100+ planned store closures; draws lessons for general business readers about over-reliance on logo-driven pricing power. Strong critical/organic independent judgment, not brand-sourced.

items.title: 木更津アウトレット GUCCI 閉店予定 post
items.summary: Organic SNS post from a shopper noting Gucci's outlet store at Kisarazu (Japan) is closing this month per staff comments that the outlet is being phased out of company strategy, alongside Miu Miu and Prada outlet closures nearby. Firsthand, non-brand-affiliated observation of retail contraction in Japan; slightly outside 7-day window but corroborates this week's closure-pattern coverage.

items.title: 뎀나의 첫 구찌 컬렉션, 패션 전문가들의 반응?
items.summary: Trade-press roundup of expert critic reactions to Demna's debut Gucci collection; cites praise for reviving 1990s Gucci archive sensibility with irony and tailoring. Included for context only (older item, not counted toward freshness-driven item total) given continued reader engagement with Demna-era design discourse referenced in this week's Shanghai-show coverage.
